metadata.title: ACDM flavored fried chicken version of Galaxy Dnynamics
metadata.description:
Working note, version 1.0 (2026-11-02). AI-assisted; not peer reviewed; not reproduced by any outside group. kappa = 1/2 is fitted; the theory is not closed; nothing here says the data favour this law over LCDM. Fried chicken is a nickname and carries no physics. An analytic stand-in for feedback, not a hydrodynamic simulation.

How easily can LCDM's knobs reproduce the law g_N = g^2/(g + a0), on the measured baryons of 171 SPARC galaxies? Twelve supernova-feedback knobs, as one global recipe, land the fitted scale within 0.3 % of a0 and 0.0415 dex from the law (0.0445 on held-out galaxies), and score 0.1953 dex against observed curves, the law scoring 0.1951. Fourteen knobs reach 0.0275 dex. Six knobs per galaxy within 2 sigma priors pass the frozen 0.02 dex target at 0.0152 dex, with at least half the galaxies at the low concentration bound. The tie to dark energy did not come from the knobs: five hand-written terms at extreme values, and kappa still narrowly missed. Tuned to the law, so a match shows freedom, not explanation. All knobs disclosed; recipes added after first numbers are marked.
